name: xAI Grok Chat Model
category_description: AI cluster sub-node (model, memory, tool, parser)
description: Use the xAI Grok Chat Model node to access xAI Grok's large language models for conversational AI and text generation tasks

parameters.name: Model
parameters.description: Select the model which will generate the completion. n8n dynamically loads available models from the xAI Grok API. Learn more in the xAI Grok model documentation

parameters.name: Frequency Penalty
parameters.description: Use this option to control the chances of the model repeating itself. Higher values reduce the chance of the model repeating itself

parameters.name: Maximum Number of Tokens
parameters.description: Enter the maximum number of tokens used, which sets the completion length. Most models have a context length of 2048 tokens with the newest models supporting up to 32,768 tokens

parameters.name: Response Format
parameters.description: Choose Text or JSON. JSON ensures the model returns valid JSON

parameters.name: Presence Penalty
parameters.description: Use this option to control the chances of the model talking about new topics. Higher values increase the chance of the model talking about new topics

parameters.name: Sampling Temperature
parameters.description: Use this option to control the randomness of the sampling process. A higher temperature creates more diverse sampling, but increases the risk of hallucinations

parameters.name: Timeout
parameters.description: Enter the maximum request time in milliseconds

parameters.name: Max Retries
parameters.description: Enter the maximum number of times to retry a request

parameters.name: Top P
parameters.description: Use this option to set the probability the completion should use. Use a lower value to ignore less probable options

parameters.name: notice
parameters.displayName: If using JSON response format, you must include word "json" in the prompt in your chain or agent. Also, make sure to select latest models released post November 2023.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: The model which will generate the completion. Learn more.

options.name: frequencyPenalty
options.description: Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim

options.name: maxTokens
options.description: The maximum number of tokens to generate in the completion. Most models have a context length of 2048 tokens (except for the newest models, which support 32,768

options.name: presencePenalty
options.description: Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics

options.name: temperature
options.description: Controls randomness: Lowering results in less random completions. As the temperature approaches zero, the model will become deterministic and repetitive.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Maximum amount of time a request is allowed to take in milliseconds

options.name: maxRetries
options.description: Maximum number of retries to attempt

options.name: topP
options.description: Controls diversity via nucleus sampling: 0.5 means half of all likelihood-weighted options are considered. We generally recommend altering this or temperature b

options.name: priority
options.description: Whether to give your xAI API requests higher scheduling priority (Priority Processing)

options.name: reasoning
options.description: Effort the model spends thinking before responding
